labs.admin_name: Leyla Omeragic Buljina (Behavioral Research Lab Coordinator)
labs.research_summary: An Institute-wide shared resource (lab facilities, participant recruitment, general support) for behavioral research at MIT, not a single PI's research group.
labs.join_notes: 'For Researchers' page linked from the About page gives instructions for MIT-affiliated researchers to use the lab; not read in this pass.
labs.notes: This is a shared service facility (recruitment, lab space) for behavioral researchers across MIT, not a PI-led research group -- recorded as a core-facility. Leadership Team is Curhan (Faculty Director), Drazen Prelec (co-leader), and Buljina (Coordinator). An 11-person 'Advisory Board' of mostly MIT Sloan faculty is also listed on the page but is an oversight body, not operational lab members, so not counted in member_count; one advisory member (John S. Carroll) is explicitly 'Emeritus'.
